datasets.prediction_time: Original binary one-year outcome, OpenML Class1=death within one year after surgery, Class2=survival; same native Risk1Yr meaning. No relabeling, transformation or alternative horizon. This is retrospective record-level annotation classification, not an established baseline prognostic or clinical-use model. PRE19's 'MI up to6months' wording is retained without inventing a precise reference-time definition for it or a universal feature-availability cutoff.

timing_and_entity_review.collection: Retrospective Wroclaw Thoracic Surgery Centre cases for major lung resections for primary lung cancer in2007-2011; part of the Polish National Lung Cancer Registry.
timing_and_entity_review.endpoint: Original binary one-year outcome, OpenML Class1=death within one year after surgery, Class2=survival; same native Risk1Yr meaning. No relabeling, transformation or alternative horizon.
timing_and_entity_review.predictors: Diagnosis, FVC/FEV1, Zubrod status, documented pre-surgery pain/haemoptysis/dyspnoea/cough/weakness, clinical tumour-size category, diabetes/MI/PAD/smoking/asthma and age at surgery.
timing_and_entity_review.no_target_components: The reviewed16predictor fields contain no death/survival indicator, one-year outcome component, follow-up length or other result target. No postoperative survival proxy is inserted.
timing_and_entity_review.timing_limit: This is retrospective record-level annotation classification, not an established baseline prognostic or clinical-use model. PRE19's 'MI up to6months' wording is retained without inventing a precise reference-time definition for it or a universal feature-availability cutoff.
timing_and_entity_review.entity_limit: Primary metadata calls instances individual patients, but identifiers/record linkage needed to independently certify patient-disjointness are not provided. The qualified tier, not a verified-entity claim, applies.
timing_and_entity_review.known_boundaries: No supplied patient/group/time keys or mandatory split constraints are discarded. Original official source splits remain intact; any experimental IID3 override requires a separately frozen protocol.

rights.approval_basis: Explicit primary UCI277 CC-BY-4.0 grant; OpenML's host license badge is not the basis.
rights.scope: Metadata-only reservation now. Later local research only after an explicitly qualified cohort freeze/release; no clinical deployment, reidentification, hosted-row sharing or additional redistribution approval.
rights.obligations: Retain source/contributor attribution and disclose retrospective collection, native coding, class imbalance and unresolved independent-patient mapping.

label_meanings.1: death within one year after surgery

V1.meaning: Diagnosis - specific combination of ICD-10 codes for primary and secondary as well multiple tumours if any

V3.meaning: Volume that has been exhaled at the end of the first second of forced expiration - FEV1 (numeric)

V10.meaning: T in clinical TNM - size of the original tumour, from OC11 (smallest) to OC14 (largest) (OC11,OC14,OC12,OC13)

Class.meaning: 1 year survival period - (T)rue value if died (T,F)

source.categorical_rule: All source NOMINAL and STRING predictors are declared categorical. Numeric FVC, FEV1 and age remain numeric.
source.payload_integrity_status: No payloads or labels acquired. The publisher MD5 pins the representation metadata, not verified downloaded bytes.
